dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Four prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped structures on the mid-lateral flank exhibit dark, high-contrast outer rings with sharp pixel-level gradients transitioning to light-grey interior regions.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Moderate density of punctate high-intensity white spots along the upper dorsal ridge; localized clusters of low-intensity dark amorphous blobs concentrated near the posterior insertion of the hind flipper.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most distal lateral rings form an irregular scalene triangle, while a sequence of smaller dorsal blobs forms a roughly linear trajectory along the longitudinal axis.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of high-contrast orange-brown organic debris (likely pine needles) adhering to the pelage across the mid-dorsal and posterior sections.
